verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only probes the root page (a script-only shell) and a legacy entry path (404). It never mentions a robots.txt file or its contents, so there is no evidence the service publishes one.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
